records.text: Albania's state anti-corruption agency opened an investigation into the Kushner-linked development project.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #2 (Ep tXoI0TTKVrs)

appearances.snippet: Earlier this week, Albania's State Anti-Corruption Agency announced it was opening an investigation into the project, though it has yet to disclose further details.

verification.notes: ANSA reports that SPAK, Albanias special anti-corruption prosecution office, confirmed opening an investigation into 2024 protected-area and land-ownership changes that enabled the development.

sources.title: ANSA: Investigation into Kushner-linked luxury resort project
sources.relevance: Reports SPAK confirmation that it opened an investigation into protected-area and land-ownership changes.
